description: Recommend a StaffBots plan from business type, optional team size, and needs (dispatch, support, scheduling, lead follow-up, admin, reseller). Returns a rationale and the signup URL. Starter, Dispatch VA, and Business in a Box are a 14-day free trial with no card. Then add a card in Billing. Does not invent discounts.

business_type.description: What kind of business this is, e.g. delivery, logistics, home services, agency, reseller, or a short description.

needs.description: Needed roles or jobs: dispatch, support, scheduling, lead follow-up, admin, and/or reseller.

team_size.description: Team size as a number or a label like 'solo', 'small', or '15'.

wants_human_oversight.description: Set true if they want a human reviewing exceptions.

name: recommend_plan
title: Recommend a StaffBots plan
